items.event: US Open men's semifinal — all-American final guaranteed
items.line: Ben Shelton stunned Carlos Alcaraz in a 5-set epic to reach the semis, where he faces fellow American Frances Tiafoe — the first all-American men's US Open final since 2003. Semis Friday; final Sunday.

items.event: US Open women's final — Sabalenka chasing a three-peat
items.line: Sabalenka outlasted Linda Noskova in a deciding-set tiebreak to reach her sixth straight US Open semifinal, bidding to become the first women's three-peat champion since Serena Williams.
